directive.scout_carefully.label: Scout Carefully
directive.scout_carefully.description: Moves carefully, scouts widely, withdraws safely, keeps intel.
pros: Party more likely to return with what they know intact
Stronger footing when a run fails or turns partial
cons: Less likely to surface signs that require exposure to find

directive.seek_signs.label: Seek Signs
directive.seek_signs.description: Presses forward, deals with whatever it runs into.
pros: Higher chance of surfacing hidden readiness clues and omen-language
Deeper intel when the run goes well
cons: Greater exposure to contact and open threat
A bad run becomes costlier than it needed to be

birth_stats._comment_growth: rank/level bonuses use (rank-1) and (level-1) offsets — 0 at birth, preserving save compat

bond_triggers._comment: All values are integers. BOND-001 defines the schema only — triggers fire in BOND-002.

drift._comment: All drift values are integers applied as deltas to morale_current or fear_current (clamped 0–100).

arch_fear_mod._comment: Archetype modifier applied to fear_base at birth (EMOTION-003). Added to stage-1 inverted courage value; result clamped 0–20.

recovery._comment: V2-SANCTUM-001: time-based recovery rates and run-outcome modifiers. Stubs marked for future systems.

buildings._comment: V2-SANCTUM-002: institution emotion-recovery multipliers by condition tier. Neglected → no modifier (gated in InstitutionService).

bonds._comment: BOND-002: grief and shared-survival recovery modifiers applied after combat based on bond outcomes.

actor._comment: Behavior Arbitration Engine (ACTOR-005). All multipliers live here — no GDScript changes needed to tune game feel or add new actions/callings/vectors/directives.

bond_behavior._comment: BOND-002: additive score adjustments applied to BehaviorArbiter candidates based on social graph bonds.

enemy_types._comment: Per-type trait values — fed to DerivedStatService using the same birth_stats formula as echoes. Add new types here; no GDScript changes needed.

pursue_quarry._comment: Fleeing quarry — high agility, moderate courage, low faith. Fast but not aggressive.

temporary_ally._comment: V2-STAGE-004 Phase 4 (S12): Temporary Ally auto-join combat template — sane mid-tier stat block, dampened further in combat via data.contact.ally.damage_mul.

structures._comment: COMBAT-006: Static structure definitions. Built via StructureActor.from_definition(). grid_pos is fixed — not placed by GridService.

actor._comment_archetype: Flat constant added inside the fear-factor bracket. Encodes combat_bias from PersonalityArchetype: aggressive=valiant/proud→melee/move, steadfast=loyal/stoic/devout→guard, supportive=empathic→protect_ally, cautious=reflective→guard/idle.
actor._comment_archetype_prog010: PROG-010 balance fixes: stoic guard 25→14, reflective guard 16→8 (reduce passive stacking). empathic protect_ally 32→18 (still highest but not dominant).

morale_action_muls._comment: Flat bonus added to the pre-fear score sum. Tiers: broken 0–24 / shaken 25–49 / steady 50–74 / inspired 75–100. steady=0 is the neutral baseline — existing scores are unchanged at default morale. PROG-010: shaken bonuses reduced to remove built-in passive bias (root cause 1 fix).

situational_muls._comment: Flat score additions per active board condition. Keys not in active_conditions are never read. _stub_ keys are never computed — zero-value placeholders for future features.

own_hp_low._comment: hp_ratio < threshold. Injured — pull back. Applies to echo and enemy.

own_hp_critical._comment: hp_ratio < threshold. Near death. Stacks with own_hp_low.

last_echo_standing._comment: All allies dead (dead_allies > 0). Final survivor mode.

enemy_far._comment: Nearest enemy distance > threshold tiles. Guard useless — advance.

echo_in_melee._comment: echo_type only. Adjacent to an enemy — fight, don't idle.

enemy_engaged._comment: enemy_type only. Adjacent to an echo — maintain pressure.

enemy_advancing._comment: enemy_type only. Not yet adjacent — close the gap.

near_friendly_structure._comment: COMBAT-006: Shrine/Totem alive — soft defensive bonus for echo actors only. Small move bonus nudges echoes toward the shrine area.

near_hostile_structure._comment: COMBAT-006: Enemy sees living shrine — boost aggression toward it.

echo_retreating._comment: PROG-010: enemy_type Adept+ only. An echo on the board has last_intent == actor.retreat — enemies give chase.

_stub_ally_adjacent._comment: STUB: a living ally in adjacent cell. Formation/support bonus.

_stub_flanked._comment: STUB: enemies on 2+ sides. Defensive pressure.

_stub_surrounded._comment: STUB: enemies on 3+ sides. Severe defensive/survival override.

_stub_in_formation._comment: STUB: 2+ allies adjacent (shield wall). Boost guard.

_stub_actor_has_ranged_skill._comment: STUB: ranged skill equipped. Move to optimal range.

_stub_weapon_extended_reach._comment: STUB: spear/halberd. Attack at dist=2 (also changes candidate generation).

_stub_enemy_type_ranged._comment: STUB: nearest enemy is ranged type. Close gap or shield up.

_stub_objective_in_range._comment: STUB: combat objective target within N tiles. Intensify toward goal.

_stub_enemy_bodyguard._comment: STUB: enemy_type protecting a priority target. Intercept aggression.

objective_in_range._comment: RECOVER holder adjacent to relic — dig in, don't wander.

objective_threatened._comment: PROTECT — enemy closing on the totem; echoes intercept.

repeated_guard_penalty._comment: COMBAT-BUG-002: fires when echo guarded last round AND enemy adjacent. Works with candidate suppression: suppression removes guard from pool; this penalty pushes melee above idle/protect_ally on the forced-action turn, and discourages guard when it re-enters the pool (HP critical exception).

quarry_near_exit._comment: PURSUE — quarry near board edge; echoes intercept urgently.

vectors._comment: Per-class_origin starting vector weights. Keys match class_origin_weights keys exactly. Add new vectors here only — no GDScript changes needed.

maturity_expression._comment: V2-PROG-006: Maturity-Expression system. Expression band derived from actor rank (Standing). Replaces smartness-tier framing. Calling-specific behavior modifiers. All thresholds config-driven.

calling_behavior._comment: Per-calling combat personality. retreat_threshold: HP ratio below which retreat is considered (null = never retreat). press_advantage: melee bonus when target hp < press_hp_threshold. directive_mul: multiplier on directive bonuses for this calling. leadership_radius: tile radius for Whole-band leadership trait effects. fear_move_bonus: flat bonus to move score per 10 fear points (kra_soro). idle_fear_aura: fear reduction applied to nearby allies when actor.idle wins (okomfo).

last_stand_fear_threshold._comment: Absolute Fear Rule threshold override when last_echo_standing is active. Replaces default 80.

rank_strength_scale._comment: V2-PROG-010: rank_strength = (rank-1)/(max_rank-1). Rank 1=0.0, rank 9=1.0. Used for all rank-scaled effects.

refusal_thresholds_by_band._comment: V2-PROG-010: Base Absolute Fear Rule threshold by expression band, before calling-specific absolute_fear_threshold override. Nascent breaks sooner, whole holds longer.

identity_weight_scale._comment: V2-PROG-010: Additional multiplier on trait_bonus and vector_bonus at rank 9 (rank_strength=1.0). At rank 1 multiplier=1.0x; at rank 9 multiplier=1.0+scale.

presence_dampen_scale._comment: V2-PROG-010: Max reduction to fear_active_dampen at rank 9. 0.4 = 40% less fear disruption at rank 9 vs rank 1.

fear_self_recovery._comment: V2-PROG-010: Passive per-round fear tick-down + active spike on identity-consistent action. Both scale with rank_strength. Identity-consistent = calling AND dominant_vector both aligned.

sanctum_fear_recovery_bonus._comment: V2-PROG-010: Bonus fear reduction per sanctum recovery tick. Starts at mid_rank_start, scales with rank_strength. calling+dominant_vector each add a small identity bonus.

directive_band_mul._comment: V2-PROG-010: Multiplier on directive bonus contribution by expression band. Nascent follows directives more literally (>1.0); whole interprets through own judgment (<1.0).

rank_benefits_config._comment: V2-PROG-010: Earned benefit definitions shown as persistent glyphs on Echo detail card. Unlocked at min_rank. Label and description are prose only — no numbers.

fear_recovery.label: Settles Quickly
fear_recovery.description: This Echo steadies between ventures. Fear lifts faster when they are home.

resilience_trait_pool._comment: Drawing weights per trait per calling_origin. Higher = more likely. All echoes draw 1-2 traits. Weighted by calling_origin then archetype.

leadership_trait_pool._comment: Available leadership traits per calling_origin. Each echo draws 1-2. Activated at Whole band.

leadership_trait_effects._comment: Numeric parameters for each leadership trait. Used by ActorStateMachine when trait activates.

rewards._comment: ECONOMY-004: Stage reward payout config. All values tunable without code changes.
rewards._comment_realm005: REALM-005: Virtue-based stage bonus. Formula: roundi((virtue_bonuses[virtue] + stage_index * stage_index_bonus_per) * (base + run_index * step)). Victory-only.

grid._comment: Combat board dimensions — immutable mid-combat; read by GridService. GRID-001. Default 10x10 for MVP (range 6x6–30x30 depending on tier — tier scaling deferred to future GRID/COMBAT story).

placement_modifiers._comment: GRID-003: Placement score modifiers. Full formula: score = floor((agi + speed) / 2) + archetype_mod + calling_mod + trait_mod + vector_mod. All read fresh at combat start (CURRENT values, not birth snapshot). Higher score = placed further forward (closer to enemies). Sort ascending by score; tiebreak actor_id ascending. Actors without a field default to 0. Add new archetypes/callings/vectors here only — no GDScript changes needed.

by_dominant_trait._comment: Dominant trait = highest value in actor.traits {courage, wisdom, faith}. Tiebreak: courage > faith > wisdom.

by_dominant_vector._comment: Dominant vector = highest value in actor.vector_scores. All 10 V2 vectors listed. Tiebreak: vanguard > opportunist > strategist > seeker > skeptic > protector > mediator > devoted > pillar > nurturer.

progression._comment: PROG-003: XP accrual and level-up config. All values tunable without code changes.
progression._comment_prog004: PROG-004: Rank-up and trait drift. vector_drift_weights must sum to 1.0 per vector key. rank_up_trait_drift_magnitude = +-N applied to one trait per rank-up.

board._comment: V2-STAGE-004 P3a: irregular combat-board sizing. Bounds = base + growth_per_completion * realm_completion_index, clamped to [base, max]. Read by FlowEncounterState; terrain generated via StageTerrain per realm virtue signature.

pursue_override._comment: V2-STAGE-004 P3b: PURSUE mode uses 4x one dimension (randomised wide or tall per encounter seed). long_multiplier applied to cols or rows.

guide_spirit_override._comment: V2-STAGE-004 P3c: GUIDE_SPIRIT mode uses 5x one dimension (randomised wide or tall per encounter seed). long_multiplier applied to cols or rows.

objective_placement._comment: V2-STAGE-004 P3a: depth-scaled objective-actor placement (shrine now; relic/entity/quarry/npc in P3/3b/3c). f = clamp(completion_index / completion_full_at, depth_min_frac, depth_max_frac). target_col = round(min_walkable_col + f * (max_walkable_col - min_walkable_col)). depth_min_frac=0.35 → first realm places shrine roughly central; depth_max_frac=1.0 → after completion_full_at completions shrine is at max-col (enemy deep). No RNG; deterministic by terrain + completion_index.

combat._comment: COMBAT-002: Initiative scoring modifiers. Formula: (speed*3 + agi*2) + arch_mod + calling_mod + trait_mod + vec_mod + nudge. Sort descending. Tiebreak: party list order. Nudge: CampaignSeed.derive_from(placement_seed, actor_id) % 10. All values tunable without code changes.

shrine._comment: COMBAT-006: Purify Shrine objective config. Drain runs after all actor turns each round. Purify slows drain — it does not heal. Purifier = highest (faith × weight_faith + vector_bonus) echo, selected once at combat init.

emotion._comment: In-combat emotion accumulation. Applied to runtime actor dicts only — does NOT affect save data (save gets standard exit deltas). fear_per_hit: fear added to defender on each melee hit. fear_per_ally_ko: fear added to all living same-faction actors when a comrade is KO'd. fear_per_round: baseline fear tick applied to all living actors at end of each round. morale_decay_n_rounds: morale decays every N rounds. morale_decay_amount: morale lost per decay tick (echo actors only).
emotion._comment_combat001: V2-COMBAT-001: New bidirectional triggers. Target balance: party landing one kill per round-pair stays below fear=40 in a standard 5-round fight.

enemy_spawn_config._comment: V2-COMBAT-001: Config-driven enemy count and group selection. base_count_by_completion_index: HOW MANY enemies (by how many realms completed). group_by_completion_index: WHICH enemy group. Completion index clamped to max available key. Count bonuses apply cumulatively within max_count cap.

by_dominant_trait._comment: Dominant trait = highest value in actor.traits {courage, wisdom, faith}. Tiebreak: courage > faith > wisdom.

by_dominant_vector._comment: Dominant vector = highest value in actor.vector_scores. All 10 V2 vectors listed. Tiebreak: vanguard > opportunist > seeker > strategist > skeptic > protector > mediator > devoted > pillar > nurturer.

by_morale_tier._comment: V2-COMBAT-001: Readiness modifier by morale tier at combat start. Mirrors EmotionService.get_morale_tier() thresholds (inspired>=75, steady>=50, shaken>=25, broken<25). Calculated once at combat start — mid-combat morale recovery does not re-sort.

objective_modes._comment: V2-STAGE-004 Phase 3: per-mode combat tuning. Read by FlowEncounterState at encounter start (data.combat.objective_modes[mode]); scaled by realm completion order; a populated ObjectiveModel.params overrides. recover=hold a relic; protect=keep entity alive N rounds; endure=survive N rounds of waves.

pursue._comment: PURSUE mode — contain a fleeing quarry before its escape window closes.

guide_spirit._comment: GUIDE_SPIRIT mode — find a named spirit, then protect it in place (skittish) or escort it to a seeded edge destination. Mode seeded 50/50 per encounter.

encounter_approach._comment: V2-STAGE-004 Phase 3: on an UNSCOUTED approach (stage_context.encounter_approach.situation_was_revealed == false), bump each echo's fear at combat start. Degrades readiness/intent via existing fear mechanics — NO initiative re-sort (readiness computed once).

charge_pressure._comment: V2-STAGE-004 Phase 4 (S13): a failed non-objective Charge sets explore_map.hostile_charge_sit_id (FlowRuntime._apply_contact_outcome charge branch). Consumed exactly once by the first PROTECT/ENDURE objective combat fought afterward — moderate bump, then cleared. Parallels the surprise_fear modifier above.

okofor.description: Bears danger for others and refuses collapse.

standing_6.descriptor: deepens into greater protection and wider safeguarding
hardens protection into forceful answer and counter-pressure

onyamesu.description: Sustains life, morale, and communal steadiness.

standing_6.descriptor: deepens care into communal memory, moral weight, and elder presence
turns sustaining care toward memory-binding, threshold tending, and the living-dead bridge

aduro.description: Meets danger directly and turns courage into momentum.

standing_6.descriptor: deepens into collective courage and war-company momentum
turns force toward disruption, timing, and opening-breaking

sum_okwanfo.description: Moves through concealment, timing, and unseen openings.

standing_6.descriptor: deepens concealment into web-path mastery and unseen passage
leans into sabotage, hidden intervention, and surgical disruption

okomfo.description: Reads spirit, sign, and hidden meaning.

standing_6.descriptor: deepens spirit-reading into omen authority and hidden-truth knowing
turns insight toward sacred thresholds, ritual control, and keeping the flame

kra_soro.description: Reads path, distance, and shifting ground.

standing_6.descriptor: deepens field-reading into route mastery and recon precision
turns field sense toward anticipation, range control, and far-seeing watch

absolute_fear_threshold_by_calling._comment: Per-calling Absolute Fear threshold override. Default is data.emotion.drift.fear_threshold (80). Edge callings break sooner (aduro 75, sum_okwanfo 70). Anchor and Sight callings endure longer (onyamesu 85, okomfo 85).

broken_morale_overrides._comment: Per-calling override of morale_action_muls at 'broken' tier. If a calling key is present, its values replace the standard broken-morale muls for that action. Aduro charges when broken; does not collapse into guard.

skills._comment: V2-PROG-005: Family-based skill system. Skills belong to one of 6 global families (ward/break/veil/path/rite/root). Callings align to families via calling_family_alignment. calling_requirement is removed — access is determined by family alignment only.

ward.name: Ward
ward.description: Protection through guarding, holding, and stabilising danger before it breaks the line.

break.name: Break
break.description: Pressure through force, disruption, momentum, and opening-making.

veil.name: Veil
veil.description: Concealment through misdirection, hidden intervention, sabotage, and surgical timing.

path.name: Path
path.description: Mastery through route-reading, pursuit, angle control, repositioning, and field sense.

rite.name: Rite
rite.description: Influence through omen-reading, thresholds, sacred procedure, revelation, and spirit authority.

root.name: Root
root.description: Endurance through care, morale, recovery, continuity, and communal steadiness.

calling_family_alignment._comment: strong = primary families (2 per calling). light = adjacent family (1 per calling). Source: GDD §11.4.5.

blade_resolve.description: Aduro's momentum made form. A strike that doesn't stop at contact — it carries the weight of every step taken to reach this moment.

warders_vigil.description: To stand between a broken ally and what threatens them. Not a decision made in the moment — a position held from the first.

stewards_ground._family_note: Hold the line: active area control before danger breaks through. Ward = danger management; Root = recovery after. Ground is pre-break, so Ward.
stewards_ground.description: Mark this line. Hold it. The echo who knows where the house ends and danger begins can defend both without surrendering either.

stewards_call.description: A voice steady enough to carry into panic. Onyamesu does not shout — they call, and those nearby find something to hold onto.

rangers_mark.description: Read the field, find the thread. The mark isn't paint — it's a name spoken into the air that turns every allied eye toward the right target.

rangers_withdraw.description: The body knows the path out before the mind finishes deciding. A clean withdrawal that makes the void look intentional.

seers_sight.description: The field is always speaking. Okomfo learns to hear it — a low, persistent reading that surfaces the hidden weights of any ground they stand on.

seers_reveal.description: What the darkness hides, the Seer names once. A moment of forced clarity that strips concealment from the target it touches.

okofor_steadfast_hold.description: Some presences don't move. Okofor learns to be the thing that stays — not through resistance alone, but through a stillness that reshapes what pressure means.

aduro_iron_momentum.description: The first hit opens something. The second follows through it. Aduro builds a rhythm others cannot interrupt — force compounding on force.

sum_okwanfo_shadow_step.description: Not hiding — choosing when to exist. The Veilrunner doesn't vanish; they step into the space between looks and arrive somewhere unexpected.

kra_soro_open_ground.description: The Ranger reads the field and sees pathways others call walls. A repositioning that isn't escape — it's preparation.

okomfo_spirit_sight.description: The spirit world overlaps every stage. Okomfo learns to see the weight of what each enemy carries — a passive knowing that sharpens every read they make.

onyamesu_steadfast_care.description: The Steward carries without collapsing. A presence that doesn't ask what others can give — it simply adds to what is already there.

calling_constellation._comment: V2-PROG-009: Radial skill tree layout config. Maps each calling × family → per-tier angle arrays (degrees, 0°=right clockwise). s3_angles length must match S3 skill count for that family. s6/s9 arrays are structural ghost-node placeholders (2 per strong family, 1 per light). Strong family 1 = upper-right (0–90°), strong family 2 = upper-left (270–360°), light = downward (~270°).

_field_contract._comment: V2-PROG-009: SkillDefinition contract — 9 required fields (was 7; added type + description). calling_requirement removed; skill_family is the V2 axis.
_field_contract.skill_family: String — one of: ward | break | veil | path | rite | root
_field_contract.action_type: String — actor intent action_type dispatched when skill fires
_field_contract.cooldown_rounds: int    — rounds before skill can fire again; 0 = no cooldown
_field_contract.scaling_source: String — stat key that scales effect e.g. 'atk', 'cha'
_field_contract.intent_weight_tag: String — tag used by BehaviorArbiter weight lookup
_field_contract.type: String — 'active' | 'passive' | 'utility'. GDD milestone package: 1 active + 1 passive + 1 utility equip cap per Standing.
_field_contract.description: String — 1-2 sentence atmospheric description shown in constellation detail strip. May be empty string.

tikoro_nko_agyina.proverb_en: One head does not constitute a council
tikoro_nko_agyina.benefit_label: Full party deployments (3+) gain fear resistance and bond momentum.
tikoro_nko_agyina.tradeoff_label: Deployments with fewer than 3 echoes incur a fear penalty.
tikoro_nko_agyina.description: One voice may carry conviction, but council is where wisdom is tested and truth survives. This vow binds the Keeper to the practice of collective strength — to send many is not doubt, it is respect. To go with few is to place the burden of the whole on shoulders not built to carry it alone.
tikoro_nko_agyina.breaking_cost_hint: Breaking this vow costs 60 Ase. A morale dip ripples through every echo in your roster. Every bond between echoes suffers a penalty.
tikoro_nko_agyina.unlock_description: The web holds a teaching for those who trust few with much — let the small number carry the weight, and let all return.

praye_wokabomu.proverb_twi: Praye, se woyi baako a na ebu; wokabomu a emmu
praye_wokabomu.proverb_en: When you remove one broomstick it breaks, but together they do not break
praye_wokabomu.benefit_label: Parties with 2+ different callings gain morale and fear resistance on stage entry.
praye_wokabomu.tradeoff_label: A party sharing a single calling origin incurs a fear penalty on stage entry.
praye_wokabomu.description: The broom is a humble thing — each strand alone will snap under pressure. But bound together, they hold. This vow asks the Keeper to honour the full weight of the sanctum: to bring many voices into the field, not the same hands over and over. Strength is not a gift of the individual — it is woven from difference.
praye_wokabomu.breaking_cost_hint: Breaking this vow costs 60 Ase. A morale penalty touches the whole roster. Every bond between echoes suffers.
praye_wokabomu.unlock_description: The web shows something to those who trust different hands with the same burden — let three paths share a stage, and let all return.

obi_nnim_kyere.proverb_en: If someone does not know, someone teaches
obi_nnim_kyere.benefit_label: Engaging a revealed situation grants morale to the party. Full-scout stages award a bonus.
obi_nnim_kyere.tradeoff_label: Engaging an unrevealed situation in the dark inflicts fear on the deployed echoes.
obi_nnim_kyere.description: Knowledge is not a private inheritance — it is passed. This vow asks the Keeper to resist the temptation of haste, to look before stepping, to learn what waits before disturbing it. The echo who walks into the unknown unprepared carries the weight of everyone who trusted them to know better.
obi_nnim_kyere.breaking_cost_hint: Breaking this vow costs 60 Ase. The roster carries the guilt of ignored counsel as a morale dip.
obi_nnim_kyere.unlock_description: When the party reads every shadow before entering it, and all return having seen everything — the web opens a deeper teaching.

_contract.vow_id: String — unique snake_case id matching proverb
_contract.benefit_label: String — one-line benefit description shown in UI
_contract.tradeoff_label: String — one-line tradeoff description shown in UI
_contract.benefit: Dict — numeric effect params read by VowService
_contract.tradeoff: Dict — numeric penalty params read by VowService
_contract.tier_effects: Dict keyed '1'-'4' — multiplier applied to benefit/tradeoff magnitudes
_contract.breaking_costs: Dict keyed '1'-'4' — penalty fields applied by VowService.break_vow()
_contract.unlock_scenario: String — scenario trigger id that reveals this vow to the Keeper
_contract.unlock_description: String — human-readable unlock condition shown as hint

institutions._comment_foundation: Foundation exception: Hearth + Training Grounds unlock early without virtue gate. Fuller gating deferred to V2-CONTINUITY-001+.

hearth.natural_fit: The Hearth recognizes something in {name}. They will settle here as if they never left.
hearth.compatible: {name} may find the Hearth quieter than expected. But stillness has its own instruction.
hearth.poor_fit: Something restless in {name} may not take easily to the care work here. They can try — watch carefully.

training_grounds.natural_fit: The Training Grounds will sharpen {name} into something formidable. This is their kind of pressure.
training_grounds.compatible: {name} will find their footing here. Readiness takes many shapes.
training_grounds.poor_fit: The Grounds may ask more of {name} than their nature offers. Not impossible — but the cost will show.

stages._note: V2-STAGE-002: Objective taxonomy, generation config, and explore action config.

recover.label: Recover
recover.reveal_hint: Something of value is hidden in this area.

endure.label: Endure
endure.reveal_hint: The pressure here does not relent.

pursue.label: Pursue
pursue.reveal_hint: Something is moving through this area.

guide_spirit.label: Guide the Spirit
guide_spirit.reveal_hint: A lost spirit lingers here, waiting to be seen home.

stages._anansi_snippet_events_note: V2-STAGE-004 P5 (playtest): Anansi travel snippets are event-driven, not cadence-based. Each key toggles whether Anansi may whisper at that narrative moment (deterministic line pick still applies). Set false to silence that moment.

result_text: The sign has been read. The party moves on, carrying what it means.
Some marks are left not to warn, but to remind. The party does not forget.
The old rite runs its course. Something settles in the air.
Ground that has been prayed over does not forget. The party rests, then walks.
Something left behind. The party gathers what they can.
It was not abandoned — it was waiting. The party takes it.
Not everything lost is gone. The party finds what remains.
Ase — misplaced, perhaps, or left as passage. The party accepts it.
An offering with no one left to receive it. The party carries it forward.
The encounter has passed. What was said stays with the party.
Not every meeting leaves a gift. This one leaves a mark.

result_text_by_choice.push_through: They did not yield. The path opened — bruised but unblocked.
result_text_by_choice.find_route: A longer road, but a clear one. The party reads the land and finds another way.

result_text_by_choice.enter: The party steps inside. The walls hold old air — and old intention.
result_text_by_choice.observe: They do not enter. They circle once, read what can be read, and move.

ally._comment: V2-STAGE-004 Phase 4 (S12): Temporary Ally auto-join tuning. def_id/level_* feed ContactActorBuilder via FlowEncounterState; damage_mul mirrors guide_spirit.spirit_damage_mul; death_*_knock apply once if the joined ally dies in battle.

claimant._comment: V2-STAGE-004 Phase 4 (S15 prep): combat_intro_line shown on the encounter/resolve screens when a hostile Claimant forces combat (see FlowRuntime stage.claimant.combat_forced).

recruitment._comment: V2-STAGE-004 Phase 4 (S14): Earned Return recruit-chance formula for a surviving temporary_ally. Additive conversation+combat+fit, base 0, never guaranteed (cap < 100). See ANSWERS.md #28/#30/#31. NOTE: vector_to_virtue_primary, rival_archetype_pairs, conversation_good_fear_max, and conversation_good_morale_min are kept here for the additive-only data/ schema rule (AGENTS.md), but at runtime RecruitmentService.build_effective_cfg AUTHORITATIVELY OVERRIDES them from their canonical single sources — data.weaving_rite.vector_to_virtue_primary, data.sanctum.rival_archetypes, and data.contact.outcome_thresholds.good. Editing the copies below has no effect on the recruit formula; tune the canonical blocks instead (kept in sync to avoid confusion).
